blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Kath Arado came out extra motivated on Saturday following her recent engagement to longtime boyfriend engineer Allan Joseph Moral. Arado delivered 22 digs in PLDT’s 25-13, 25-23, 23-25, 25-18 win over Galeries Tower to stay in semifinal contention in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Saklab Series on Saturday at Philsports Arena. “I was really excited for this game because I had a different kind of motivation even before stepping onto the court,” said Arado in Filipino. “I already felt it during training.
